title.en: Writing to and reading from a text file

heading.en: Put it in, get it back

hook.en: Your diary is useful only if you can write in it and read it back later. Python gives two ways to write and three ways to read a text file.
hook.kn: ದಿನಚರಿ ಬರೆಯಲು ಮತ್ತು ನಂತರ ಓದಲು ಸಾಧ್ಯವಾದರೆ ಮಾತ್ರ ಉಪಯುಕ್ತ. ಪೈಥಾನ್ ಬರೆಯಲು ಎರಡು, ಓದಲು ಮೂರು ವಿಧಾನಗಳನ್ನು ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ.

objectives.en: Split file contents into words and lines

narration.en: Your diary is useful only if you can write in it and read it back later. Python gives two ways to write and three ways to read a text file.
narration.kn: ದಿನಚರಿ ಬರೆಯಲು ಮತ್ತು ನಂತರ ಓದಲು ಸಾಧ್ಯವಾದರೆ ಮಾತ್ರ ಉಪಯುಕ್ತ. ಪೈಥಾನ್ ಬರೆಯಲು ಎರಡು, ಓದಲು ಮೂರು ವಿಧಾನಗಳನ್ನು ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: Open the file in w or a mode. write(string) writes one string and returns the number of characters written; numbers must be converted with str() first, and \n must be added to end a line. writelines(iterable) writes every string of a list or tuple, adds no newlines of its own, and returns None. Data is buffered in memory and reaches the disk when the file is closed.

narration.en: Open the file in w or a mode. write(string) writes one string and returns the number of characters written; numbers must be converted with str() first, and \n must be added to end a line. writelines(iterable) writes every string of a list or tuple, adds no newlines of its own, and returns None. Data is buffered in memory and reaches the disk when the file is closed.
narration.kn: w ಅಥವಾ a ಮೋಡ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ತೆರೆಯಿರಿ. write() ಒಂದು ಸ್ಟ್ರಿಂಗ್ ಬರೆದು ಅಕ್ಷರಗಳ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ. writelines() ಪಟ್ಟಿಯ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಸ್ಟ್ರಿಂಗ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ಬರೆಯುತ್ತದೆ, ಹೊಸ ಸಾಲು ಸೇರಿಸುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.

title.en: On the board: Writing lines and reading them back

say.en: write writes one string and returns the number of characters written. We must add backslash n ourselves.
read of 3 reads three characters: P, y, t.
readline reads from there to the end of the line, including the newline: hon and backslash n.
readlines reads all remaining lines into a list.
writelines writes every string of a list and adds no newlines; it returns None.

narration.en: We write a two-line file, then read it with read(n), readline() and readlines(), tracking where each read stops.

prompt.en: Match each file method with what it does or returns.
prompt.kn: ಪ್ರತಿ ಕಡತ ವಿಧಾನವನ್ನು ಅದು ಮಾಡುವ/ಕೊಡುವದರೊಂದಿಗೆ ಹೊಂದಿಸಿ.

right.en: Writes one string and returns 3, the number of characters
Writes every string of the list, adding no newlines of its own
Returns the rest of the file as one string
Returns a list of all the remaining lines

left.en: readline() at the end of the file

explanation.en: write and writelines need strings and add nothing extra, so we put \n ourselves. read, readline and readlines all start at the current offset; an empty string means the end of the file.
explanation.kn: write, writelines ಗೆ ಸ್ಟ್ರಿಂಗ್ ಬೇಕು, \n ನಾವೇ ಸೇರಿಸಬೇಕು. ಖಾಲಿ ಸ್ಟ್ರಿಂಗ್ ಎಂದರೆ ಕಡತದ ಅಂತ್ಯ.

body.en: read(n) reads n bytes (characters) from the current position; read() or read(-1) reads the rest of the file. readline(n) reads one line up to and including \n (or n characters); it returns an empty string at the end of the file. readlines() returns all lines as a list of strings. split() breaks a line into words and splitlines() breaks text into lines.

narration.en: read(n) reads n bytes (characters) from the current position; read() or read(-1) reads the rest of the file. readline(n) reads one line up to and including \n (or n characters); it returns an empty string at the end of the file. readlines() returns all lines as a list of strings. split() breaks a line into words and splitlines() breaks text into lines.
narration.kn: read(n) n ಅಕ್ಷರಗಳನ್ನು, read() ಉಳಿದ ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ಕಡತವನ್ನು ಓದುತ್ತದೆ. readline() ಒಂದು ಸಾಲು ಓದುತ್ತದೆ; ಕೊನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಖಾಲಿ ಸ್ಟ್ರಿಂಗ್. readlines() ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಸಾಲುಗಳ ಪಟ್ಟಿ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ.

problem.en: Write two lines to a file and read them back in three different ways. Give the exact output.

steps.en: f.writelines(["Writing multiline strings\n", "This is the third line"])

homework.en: Write a program that counts the lines, words and characters in a text file.

narration.en: Recap. write() returns the number of characters; writelines() takes a list of strings. Neither adds \n for you. read(n) reads characters, readline() one line, readlines() a list of lines.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. write() ಅಕ್ಷರಗಳ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ; writelines() ಸ್ಟ್ರಿಂಗ್ ಪಟ್ಟಿ ಸ್ವೀಕರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಎರಡೂ \n ಸೇರಿಸುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. read(n) ಅಕ್ಷರಗಳು, readline() ಒಂದು ಸಾಲು, readlines() ಸಾಲುಗಳ ಪಟ್ಟಿ.
